text:
RICHARD:
  Lady, you don't know the rules of charity.
  Charity pays back bad with good, and curses with blessings.
ANNE:
  You villain, you don't know the law of God or of man.
  There's no beast so savage it doesn't feel a little pity.
RICHARD:
  But I feel none, so I'm no beast.
ANNE:
  Oh, what a wonder, when devils tell the truth!
RICHARD:
  A bigger wonder when angels get this angry.
  Divine perfection of a woman, please allow me this.
  These crimes you think I've committed, let me answer them.
  Let me go through it all in detail, and clear my name.
